description: Land Title Settlement Department - Saliyapura, Lunugamwehera D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830062
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (Nos. 68 and 69) in Hambantota District, including detailed ownership information, property extent, and legal encumbrances. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in Type 4 classification.
